theme: An open Friday in St. Pete, Halloween eve with the girls.
greeting: The whole day is open, Dan - nothing on the calendar, the girls here with you and Mike in St. Pete, and Halloween tomorrow. A quiet Friday, with a couple of holiday bookings that have been waiting for exactly this kind of gap.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The top-priority item on your board since mid-September. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market and sells out; a refundable hold now takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: December break destinations
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by and book-by dates (Sept 30, Oct 15) have both passed, and holiday inventory for six over a three-week window only thins from here.

flagged.title: KLA - VP, Global Government Affairs
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn alert surfaced a VP role in global government affairs and strategic policy - squarely in your lane. Worth a glance before it ages out.

inbox.noise: The rest of the last two days is promotions, parking receipts, Zillow, and newsletters.

recipe.why: Autumn's root vegetables are at their earthy, deep sweetness right now.
